The Chill Ride

Memphis, TN · Road · Social

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

The Chill Ride is a road and social group ride in Memphis, TN. It rolls every Sunday at 2:00 pm from Rotates: Overton Park, Big River Crossing, Shelby Farms, Crosstown Brewery and others. About 10–20 miles, d, 16 mph max. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 2:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Chill Ride group ride

The Hightailers' slowest club ride. Ten to twenty miles, capped at 16 mph, no-drop. Start location changes week to week and is posted in the Facebook group. Helmets required on all club rides.
